name: unpaired-surrogate
description: A member name, in a member a reader ignores, holds the escape \ud800: half of a UTF-16 surrogate pair with no other half. A string escaping an unpaired surrogate is not valid text, wherever it stands (member names and members a reader ignores included), so the whole answer is refused (rule 6). It is never repaired, by a replacement character or otherwise. The body is given as text so that the escape reaches the client exactly as written.
